sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.price * o.quantity_product), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE date(o.date) >= date(c.birth_date, '+25 years') AND date(o.date) < date(c.birth_date, '+26 years')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.price * o.quantity_product), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE date('2026-12-01') >= date(c.birth_date, '+25 years') AND date('2026-12-01') < date(c.birth_date, '+26 years')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.price * o.quantity_product), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')
